general.ruta_pendiente_calculo: Select the route and calculate it before saving the draft.
general.ruta_puerto_no_disponible: The routing tool is not connected for this session.
general.ruta_calculo_completado: Route calculated by the internal port. Review the legs, alternative and adjustments.
general.ruta_error_servicio: The route could not be calculated because the internal mapping service is unavailable. Please try again later.
general.descripcion: Official trips, mileage and expenses with receipts for recorded actions.
general.operacion_en_curso: There is an Expenses operation in progress.
general.mapa_nota_no_disponible: The internal map is unavailable. No cartographic simulation is shown.
general.mapa_nota_osm_interno: OpenStreetMap loaded from tiles served on the internal network. Historical map source; full coverage of the province and its 15 km strip has not yet been confirmed.
general.borradores_propios_ruta_ayuda: The distance and the provisional amount are calculated with the internal road calculation when the draft is saved.
general.borradores_propios_grupo_pendiente: Staff group pending accreditation: the three provisional amounts are shown, without choosing one for you.
general.borradores_propios_vacio: There are no drafts of your own yet.
general.borradores_propios_repeticion: The previous request has been retrieved without creating another draft.
general.borradores_propios_creado_listado_no_act: Draft registered; the inbox could not be updated. Check the list again without creating the draft a second time.
general.borradores_propios_error: The operation could not be completed. Check the data and try again.
general.borradores_propios_error_relacion: No available relationship can be determined for this trip. The draft has not been created.
general.borradores_propios_error_conflicto: This operation's key was already used with different data. Create a new intent to continue.
general.borradores_propios_error_incierto: The outcome could not be confirmed. You may retry the exact same operation.
general.borradores_propios_pendiente_conexion: Creating and viewing drafts is pending connection to the authorised service.

borradores.borradores_propios_ya_registrado_ayuda: Check its receipt or change the data to start another one.
borradores.borradores_propios_detalle_no_actualizad: The detail could not be updated. The last receipt obtained is kept.
borradores.borradores_propios_detalle_denegado: You do not have permission to view this detail. The last receipt obtained is kept.
borradores.borradores_propios_creado_listado_denega: Draft registered. You do not have permission to update the inbox; keep the receipt and do not create the draft again.
borradores.borradores_propios_fechas_invalidas: The return must be later than the departure. Check the dates and times.
borradores.borradores_propios_consulta_denegada: You do not have permission to view your Expenses drafts.
borradores.borradores_propios_creacion_denegada: You do not have permission to create an Expenses draft.
borradores.borradores_propios_autenticacion_requeri: You must identify yourself again to view or create Expenses drafts.
borradores.borradores_propios_consulta_registrados: Drafts checked. The list does not confirm earlier submissions.
borradores.borradores_propios_consulta_registrados_: No drafts in this check. The list does not confirm earlier submissions.
borradores.borradores_propios_consulta_ayuda: If a creation was left unconfirmed, check the list. Choose a draft to view its receipt. Its appearing on the list does not prove it corresponds to that attempt; do not create another one just to check it.
borradores.comision_pais_sin_calculo: No calculation available for a foreign destination. The rate and rule must be governed before saving this trip.
borradores.borradores_propios_preparacion_ayuda: You can correct the fields before registering the draft. The country is shown from the available provincial catalogue; the service does not yet record country separately. Reviewing does not save or send data.
borradores.borradores_propios_paradas_ayuda: Order the itinerary from the origin to the destination, with a maximum of 12 distinct locations. Reviewing shows the sequence without registering it. The return, if applicable, requires a separate trip or route; this itinerary is not a round trip.
borradores.borradores_propios_paradas_distintas: Select between 2 and 12 distinct locations across the whole itinerary.
borradores.comision_bloque_dietas_ayuda: The amounts and allowance items are provisional until confirmed by HR. The staff group is accredited by Personnel; it is not chosen here.
borradores.comision_nivel_ayuda: The level only changes how much detail is shown. It does not change the group, rate or amounts.
borradores.comision_aceptacion_sin_tramos: There are no allowance items for this trip.
borradores.comision_aceptacion_ayuda: You may only accept one or all of the allowance items calculated for the group accredited by Personnel. The accommodation maximum requires a receipt and is not the same as final settlement.
borradores.comision_aceptacion_error: Choose one or all of the allowance items for the accredited group before saving.
borradores.comision_total_dietas: Provisional subsistence for the accredited group
borradores.comision_total_provisional: Estimated total for the accredited group
borradores.comision_total_sin_grupo: There is no individual total until the Personnel group is checked; submission remains closed.
borradores.comision_grupo_documento: Group accredited when this document was saved
borradores.comision_bloque_kilometraje_ayuda: The route is calculated with the internal road calculation. The amount per kilometre and any adjustment require a version and a justification kept in the file.
borradores.comision_ajuste_error: Enter an adjustment of up to 1,000 km with four decimal places and justify it if it is not zero.
borradores.comision_otros_primero_guardar: Save the trip first to add expenses with a receipt.
borradores.comision_total_no_definitivo: The final total remains pending the accredited group, receipts and HR validation.
borradores.comision_envio_confirmado: Submission registered with receipt. Review is still pending.
borradores.comision_accion_no_disponible: This operation requires the authorised Expenses service and a verified assignment.
borradores.comision_envio_sin_documento: Complete and save all three blocks of the document before submitting it for review.
borradores.comision_conflicto_version: The draft has changed. Check its detail again before continuing.
borradores.comision_asignacion_pendiente: Centre, unit and approvers pending authorised lookup.
borradores.comision_asignacion_sin_datos: No verified assignment is on record for this relationship.
borradores.comision_asignacion_error: The assignment could not be checked. Submission remains closed.
borradores.comision_empleado_no_disponible: No current employee is on record linked to your user account. Creation and submission are closed.
borradores.comision_empleado_ambiguo: Several current employees are on record linked to your user account. Creation and submission are closed until HR resolves this.
borradores.comision_relaciones_no_disponibles: The Personnel relationships could not be checked. You may view the inbox; creation and submission are closed.
borradores.comision_asignacion_corregir_pendiente: The correction is handled by your unit's administrator; there is no request in the portal yet.
borradores.comision_asignacion_nombre_no_disponible: Name not available in this projection
borradores.comision_confirmar_reenviar: Resend the document to the administrator's review?
borradores.comision_reenvio_confirmado: Resubmission registered with receipt. The document returns to the administrator's review.

circuito.circuito_sin_fuente: Without an authorised list of approvers per unit, documents cannot be assigned for review.
circuito.circuito_vacio_filtros: There are no documents for these dates.
circuito.circuito_error: The inbox could not be checked.
circuito.circuito_denegado: You do not have permission to view this inbox.
circuito.circuito_autenticacion: Your session does not allow viewing this inbox.
circuito.circuito_documento_error: The document could not be opened.
circuito.circuito_motivo_invalido: The reason is too long or contains unsupported characters. Shorten it and use a single line.
circuito.circuito_motivo_devolucion_incompleto: Write a fuller reason to return the document.
circuito.circuito_decision_invalida: State the reason for the return (between 3 and 600 characters).
circuito.circuito_conflicto: The document has changed or is no longer pending. Refresh the inbox.
circuito.circuito_no_encontrada: The document is no longer in this inbox.
circuito.circuito_error_decision: This could not be registered. The document is still pending.
circuito.circuito_incierto: The outcome has not been confirmed. Repeat the same action to retrieve its receipt.

otros_gastos.otros_gastos_ayuda: Add each ticket, taxi, parking or toll for the trip with its date and amount. The receipt stays with you: give a reference to locate it and its SHA-256 fingerprint, which you can calculate by choosing the file; the file itself is not sent.
otros_gastos.otros_gastos_huella_error: The file's fingerprint could not be calculated.
otros_gastos.otros_gastos_huella_grande: The file is over 25 MB and its fingerprint cannot be calculated here.
otros_gastos.otros_gastos_linea_anterior: The type, date or receipt for this expense is missing; complete them before saving.
otros_gastos.otros_gastos_error: Check each expense: type, date within the trip, description, amount, receipt reference (letters, numbers, «:», «_» or «-») and SHA-256 fingerprint.
otros_gastos.otros_gastos_sin_catalogo: Expense types are not available at this time.

rectificacion_admin.ra_ayuda: The employee's request does not change the assignment. Confirmation requires the decision and correction authorised by Personnel; rejection keeps the reason and the history.
rectificacion_admin.ra_vacio: There are no pending requests within the authorised scope.
rectificacion_admin.ra_denegado: You are not authorised to view these requests.
rectificacion_admin.ra_autenticacion: Your session must identify itself again to view these requests.
rectificacion_admin.ra_error_lista: The requests could not be checked. Try again.
rectificacion_admin.ra_error_ficha: The record could not be checked. Try again.
rectificacion_admin.ra_conflicto: The request or the assignment has changed. Refresh the record before deciding.
rectificacion_admin.ra_incierto: The outcome has not been confirmed. Repeat the same decision to retrieve the receipt.
rectificacion_admin.ra_ficha_vacia: Select a request to review its content.
rectificacion_admin.ra_ficha_pendiente: This request is still pending a decision.
rectificacion_admin.ra_asignacion_cambiada: The assignment changed after the request. Only confirm after a new request; you may reject this one with a reason.
rectificacion_admin.ra_catalogo_disponible: Authorised options loaded for this request.
rectificacion_admin.ra_catalogo_no_disponible: There are no authorised options to correct this assignment. Confirmation is disabled; you may reject with a reason.
rectificacion_admin.ra_catalogo_denegado: You are not authorised to view correction options. Confirmation is disabled.
rectificacion_admin.ra_dato_no_disponible: Data not available without an authorised catalogue
rectificacion_admin.ra_nueva: Correction proposed by the competent person
rectificacion_admin.ra_motivo_ayuda: Explain the decision with at least three characters. Do not write personal identifiers in the reason.
rectificacion_admin.ra_confirmar_aviso: Confirm the correction of this assignment?
rectificacion_admin.ra_invalido: Check the reason and all the correction data.

rectificacion_dietas.rectificacion_intro: State the assignment data that needs reviewing. The request does not change the assignment.
rectificacion_dietas.rectificacion_vacia: There is no correction request on record for this assignment.
rectificacion_dietas.rectificacion_error: The correction request could not be checked.
rectificacion_dietas.rectificacion_denegada: Your session does not have permission to view or request this correction.
rectificacion_dietas.rectificacion_invalida: Select at least one field and state a reason of at least 3 characters.
rectificacion_dietas.rectificacion_conflicto: The assignment has changed. Refresh the data before requesting the correction.
rectificacion_dietas.rectificacion_incierta: The outcome has not been confirmed. Repeat the same request to retrieve its receipt.
rectificacion_dietas.rectificacion_ayuda: The request remains pending review. It does not by itself change the data held by Personnel.
